issues.where: the liquid and background seen through the glass sphere (also in set-B-01-b.jpg)
issues.what: the interior of the globe is filled with a flat, opaque-looking milky tan haze from top to bottom instead of crystal-clear liquid showing the deep dark night background through the upper dome, killing contrast and particle glow
issues.fix: make the glass and liquid optically clear so the dark teal-black background reads cleanly through the upper dome and behind the particles, confining warm atmospheric glow to the lit lower clearing and lanterns

issues.where: the swirled particles in the liquid and over the pond
issues.what: instead of long, curved, motion-blurred golden-white vortex filaments sweeping continuously across the cottage, tree, and glass and surging over the pond to hide it, the particles appear as un-streaked round fuzzy puffs clumped on the sides with short stiff dashes, leaving the pond water calm and uncovered
issues.fix: stretch and motion-blur the dandelion seeds, motes, and yellow-green fireflies along sweeping spiral flow lines across the entire globe, including bright streaked currents across the cottage and a dense glowing surge that obscures the pond

issues.where: the right flank of the base above the sand mound
issues.what: the bright backlit stream of fine golden sand cascading down from the upper-right rim of the base onto the sand mound is completely missing
issues.fix: add the sunlit curtain of fine sparkling golden sand grains spilling from the right shoulder of the base onto the crest of the sand mound

issues.where: the cascading sand on the right flank of the base
issues.what: the falling sand renders as a stiff opaque white strip stuck to the upper stone alongside a few sparse, rigid dotted arcs in mid-air instead of a dense, backlit shower of fine golden grains
issues.fix: replace the white ribbon and dotted arcs with a soft-edged, sunlit cascade of fine individual golden sand grains hugging the base slope onto the sand mound

issues.where: the glass rim, upper dome reflections, upper-right flare, and lower-left inner edge
issues.what: the sphere lacks visible clear glass wall thickness and cool bluish curved surface reflections across the upper dome, shows a heavy orange inner band with a geometric 8-point star at the upper right and a featureless white blob at the lower left, and cuts the dark ground off as a flat horizontal shelf against the glass
issues.fix: render a thick clear refractive glass rim with cool curved sky reflections on the upper dome, soften the upper-right highlight into a natural optical rim flare, replace the lower-left blob with curved refractive glass striations, and curve the inner terrain smoothly up the glass meniscus with warm golden caustics

issues.where: the collar where the glass meets the base
issues.what: a coarse, crusty gravel band sits above a harsh dark horizontal seam on a flat base top rather than smooth fine sand inside curved glass tucked into a recessed stone lip
issues.fix: replace the noisy gravel ring with fine smooth cream sand inside the curved bottom of the glass sphere, and seat the glass into a smooth rounded sandstone collar with soft contact shadow

issues.where: the base profile, sandstone lighting, shells, and sea glass
issues.what: the base has a symmetrical lathe-like profile and flat, grainy olive-brown matte texture with opaque pastel-painted sea glass and dull grey-tan shells, losing the rolled upper lip, protruding lower-left rock ledge, warm sunlit upper-left rim light against cool slate-blue shadow, crisp white shells, and glowing translucent sea glass
issues.fix: sculpt the rolled upper lip and asymmetric lower-left rock shelf, rake warm golden sunlight across the upper-left sandstone strata while cooling the shaded front and right toward slate-blue, brighten the shells to pearlescent white with crisp contact shadows, and make the sea glass thick, glossy, and translucent with warm internal light transmission

issues.where: the interior ground clearing, pond, left wooden fence, and sunflowers
issues.what: the grassy clearing lacks the bright golden light pool behind the lamp post and around the tree roots, the left fence disappears into near-black shadow, the pond has a uniform grey pebble necklace and harsh black-and-white block reflections, and the sunflowers are flat front-facing yellow-and-black cartoon discs
issues.fix: add radiant warm golden bounce light across the clearing behind the lamp and tree base, catch warm rim light on the tan wooden fence, blend the pond edge into soft mossy sand-dusted banks reflecting warm golden light, and angle the sunflowers naturally with delicate backlit translucent petals

issues.where: the cottage, tree, and string lanterns
issues.what: the cottage has an overly tall mossy chimney, glittering roof speckles, dark rubble walls with a dim left window, a narrow orange door without its pale stone arch, and chunky bright-green/neon-pink vine clumps; the tree trunk is nearly black and the canopy is dark crunchy leaf points; and the lanterns (especially in set-B-01-b.jpg) look flat orange without bright glowing cores
issues.fix: lower the chimney and matte the dark slate roof, lighten the warm cobbles and stone door arch while brightening the left window and softening the climbing roses, give the tree a warm gnarled brown trunk and softer painterly backlit olive foliage, and add hot incandescent cores with warm bloom to the lanterns

issues.where: the particles in the calm liquid across the upper dome and in front of the scene
issues.what: dandelion seeds cluster heavily in the upper-left quadrant leaving the top-center and upper-right sparse, almost no seeds or bokeh orbs float in front of the tree or cottage, and the seeds read as flat 2D radial stamps at one sharpness
issues.fix: spread dandelion seeds, yellow-green fireflies, and golden motes evenly through the full 3D globe volume including above and in front of the tree and cottage, adding soft out-of-focus depth-of-field bokeh discs for near and far particles

issues.where: the surface around the base, right sand mound, mirror reflections, and background bokeh lights
issues.what: the foreground surface is tinted murky warm brown with stray mid-left sand speckles and lacks the deep cool dark cast shadow extending forward-left from the base foot and crisp golden water-ripple glints on the right; the right sand mound looks smooth and blurry without sparkling backlit grains; and the background loses the dense overlapping cluster of large golden bokeh circles in the upper right and warm bokeh on the left edge
issues.fix: restore the dark cool wet surface with a crisp cast shadow to the left of the base and subtle warm mirror reflections, add horizontal golden specular glints on the right water surface and sparkling backlit sand grains on the right mound crest, remove the mid-left sand speckles, and build up overlapping bright golden bokeh circles in the upper-right and left background
